results.title: Viewer is read-only everywhere
results.expected: No New flag, edit, delete, API keys; switches disabled; read-only notes say why

results.title: Flags list says who gets each flag in plain English
results.expected: Partial/Partial/Off in prod with the seed audience sentences

results.title: A prod switch asks first and says who is affected
results.expected: Dialog before any change; Cancel changes nothing; Confirm turns it on

results.title: A typed ID is saved even without pressing Enter
results.expected: u_501 saved into prod rule 1
notes: Server rule 1 after save: u_102, u_207, u_501

results.title: A malformed ID is blocked with a clear message
results.expected: bad#id stays in the box, message names it, Save disabled

results.title: Two admins edit the same rules: no silent overwrite
results.expected: B is told someone else changed them; A's change stands
notes: Server kept A's rules: customers acme, globex

results.title: Activity search finds changes across all history
results.expected: "rollout" finds "rollout 10% → 20%", highlighted, (all matches)

results.title: A new API key's token is shown once only
results.expected: Token + client config shown once; gone after reload
notes: Token blurred in the recording and screenshots.

results.title: No flicker on first load, even on slow 3G
results.expected: First paint is already the new dashboard; classic home never appears
notes: Loaded in 10.8 s throttled; storefront blocks seen in order: new-dashboard, beta-reports

results.title: Each demo user gets exactly the expected flags
results.expected: All six users match the prod oracle (storefront + debug reasons)

results.title: Dev turns the store dark via the dark-mode flag
results.expected: All flags ON (Otherwise ON); data-theme=dark; admin's dark palette

results.title: The evaluate API returns results only, never rules
results.expected: Only value/reason/ruleIndex/ruleType; no IDs, lists or percentages

results.title: An admin change reaches the storefront without a reload
results.expected: Eli gets the new dashboard within seconds of the save
notes: Storefront updated 0.3 s after Save, with no reload

results.title: Backend down: the store keeps its last known flags
results.expected: Stale banner; storefront unchanged
notes: Stale banner appeared 29 s after the backend stopped, without user action

results.title: Nothing cached and backend down: all OFF, then recovers
results.expected: Red banner, classic home, no crash; recovers by itself after restart
notes: Recovered on its own 26 s after the backend was healthy

results.title: A revoked key fails on the very next call
results.expected: whoami works, revoke in the admin, next call is 401

results.title: Even an admin key can't manage keys
results.expected: /api/keys rejects the key; no MCP tool manages keys

results.title: An editor key can't change prod
results.expected: set_flag_enabled on prod is refused with a plain message; nothing changes

results.title: A stale version is a conflict, not an overwrite
results.expected: Second write with the old version is refused; first write stands

results.title: Bad rules get one clear message naming the field
results.expected: Invalid ID, percent 101, empty list, unknown type: each one plain message

results.title: Agent changes are in the audit log as key:<name>
results.expected: Activity → Who: Agents lists the agent's changes

results.title: Agent rolls new-dashboard in prod out to 20%
results.expected: Reads the flag, updates the % rule with the current version; audit says rollout 10% → 20%
notes: Driven by the MCP tool calls an agent makes (scripted, no LLM in the loop).

results.title: Progressive rollout 10% → 50% → 100% only ever adds users
results.expected: Each step's users are a superset of the last; nobody loses the feature
notes: Users with it: 10% → 55/400, 50% → 210/400, 100% → 400/400; nobody lost it between steps
Audit (oldest first): added rule: 10% rollout · turned ON · rollout 10% → 50% · rollout 50% → 100%

results.title: Kill switch: turning a prod flag off removes it for everyone, live
results.expected: Storefront shows OFF live; rules kept
notes: Storefront showed OFF 0.2 s after the switch, no reload
50 sampled users all OFF; the 100% rule is kept

results.title: Editor can't change prod: UI, API or MCP
results.expected: All three refused; prod unchanged; no audit entry
